entities.name: George XII of Georgia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: George XII, sometimes known as George XIII, of the Bagrationi dynasty, was the second and last king (mepe) of the Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti in eastern Georgia from 1798 until his death in 1800.
